RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the November 28, 2007/Agrahayana 7, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Information and
Broadcasting; Labour and Employment; Parliamentary Affairs; Rural
Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
Setting up Leather Parks
*181. SHRIMATI  PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRI  SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is considering
setting up Leather Parks in the country;
(b) if so, the details of the scheme and
what fiscal and financial incentives shall
be given to these Parks;
(c) whether locations of such Parks have
been identified;
(d) if so, who identifies the location,
and what is the size of such Parks;
(e) who will be responsible for
developing the infrastructure in such Parks;
and
(f) what will be the role and obligations
of the respective State Governments?
SEZs in Gujarat
*182. SHRI PRAVEEN
RASHTRAPAL: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of Special Economic
Zones (SEZs) granted permission in
Gujarat as on 30th June, 2007;
(b) the names of industrial houses or
industrial groups owning maximum SEZs
in Gujarat;
(c) the details of agriculture land and
Government wasteland under each SEZ,
zone-wise; and
(d) the details of present status of each
SEZ?
National Child Labour Projects
Scheme
*183. SHRI DARA SINGH: Will the
Minister of  LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether on “World Day Against
Child Labour” this year, Government
formulated “National Child Labour
Projects Scheme” (NCLPS) for welfare and
rehabilitation of children below 14 years
of age;
(b) if so, the salient features of NCLPS
indicating the number of districts covered,
till date;

58
(c) the number of occupations/
processes which are considered hazardous,
banned by Government for employment of
children aged between 5 to 14 after 2006,
when child labour was declared illegal; and
(d) the budgetary allocations made
during 2007-08 for welfare programmes of
children in comparison to 2006-07 as well
as during the Eleventh Plan period?
Blacking out of TV Channels by
Gujarat Government
*184. SHRIMATI SYEDA ANWARA
TAIMUR: Will the Minister of
INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
Aaj Tak, NDTV and CNN-IBN were
blacked out in Ahmedabad by Gujarat
Government in October, 2007;
(b) if so, whether All India Cable
Operators Association has filed a complaint
against this gagging of freedom of
electronic and print media; and
(c) whether Government has devised or
is devising effective safeguards so that
freedom of electronic and print media is
not arbitrarily denied on whimsical
grounds?
Sanctioned and actual strength of BSF
personnel
*185. SHRI VARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the sanctioned and the actual
strength of BSF personnel as on 1st April,
2007, cadre-wise;
(b) the areas where the gap between the
sanctioned and actual strength of personnel
is more than five per cent and the reasons
therefor, cadre-wise; and
(c) the steps taken and proposed to
ensure that the gap between the sanctioned
and actual strength of the force is reduced
to the minimum so as to maintain the proper
efficiency and availability of the force?
Resentment among small traders
against FDI in retail
*186. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware about
the strong resentment amongst the small
traders over the entry of Foreign Direct
Investment (FDI) and corporate houses in
the retail sector;
(b) whether Government had received
any protest from the small traders in this
regard and if so, the details thereof; and
(c) Government's reaction in regard
thereto?
Allocation of fund to Bihar under
PMGSY
†*187. SHRI ALI ANWAR: Will the
Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the amount made available to Bihar
under Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana
(PMGSY) to connect all the villages of the
country with the Pucca road by 2010;
(b) by when all the villages of Bihar
are proposed to be connected with the
Pucca roads;
(c) whether it is a fact that violations of
the norms have been noticed at occasions
in the implementation of this scheme; and
(d) the measures proposed to be taken
to prevent recurrence of the violations?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

59
Initiatives to check crime rate in
metropolitan cities
*188. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any effective initiatives with
planning have been taken by Central
Government to check the growing crime
rate in the metropolitan/big cities of the
country;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?

the Minister of TEXTI

Revamping tea industry
855. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India exported
211 million kg. of tea in 1998, but the figure
fell to 200 million kg. in 2006, and India's
tea exports declined to 75.7 million kg. in
the first half of this year despite the fact
that India has around 28 per cent of global
tea production;
(b) whether it is also a fact that a
considerable number of tea gardens have
gone sick due to lack of infrastructure,
modernization and efficient management;
and
(c) if so, the steps Government propose
to take to revamp the tea industry?
WTO in Doha
†856. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the biggest
obstruction in the progress of present
development Round of WTO in Doha is
the obstinacy of developed countries that
they are not ready to reduce the huge
subsidy which they are giving to farmers in
their countries;
(b) if so, the measures suggested by
developed countries to solve this problem;
and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
ensure livelihood of farmers and
employment to workers at a time when
India's target is to achieve nine per cent
growth in economy?
SEZs sanctioned
†857. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the number of Special Economic
Zones (SEZs) sanctioned in the country,
so far;
(b) the total area of land acquired under
this scheme, the details thereof, State-wise;
(c) whether it is a fact that only new
companies are getting benefit from this
scheme but the undertakings already existing
in that region are not getting any benefit
from this;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(d) the number of persons displaced
from this acquisition; the details thereof,
State-wise; and
(e) the details of total amount likely to
be invested in these Special Economic
Zones and the number of people likely to
get jobs in these zones?
Permission for FDI
†858. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: W ill the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the extent to which Foreign Direct
Investment (FDI) has been allowed till date
during the last three years;
(b) the number of FDI proposals under
Governments consideration as on date; and
(c) the latest position of these
proposals?
SEZ Infocity-II at Orissa
859. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MS. PRAMILA
BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Centre has asked the
Orissa Government to expedite their SEZ
Infocity-II and Manceshwar Industrial
Area;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of help, both financial
and physical that is proposed to be given
by the Centre to achieve the above
objective?
World class infrastructure facilities
for exporters
860. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to create
world class infrastructural facilities to help
exporters especially of textiles;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Additional administrative and
regulatory staff for SEZs
861. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has so far
accorded formal and in-principle approvals
for more than 500 Special Economic Zones
throughout the country;
(b) if so, whether the commissioners of
different SEZs have requisitioned additional
staff both for administrative and regulatory
work including personnel for excise and
customs; and
(c) whether it would be more expedient,
that creation of posts and posting of
officials for SEZs be done alongwith the
notification of an SEZ?
FTA with Brazil and South Africa
862. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether India has concluded talks
with Brazil and South Africa with regard to
entering into Free Trade Agreement (FTA);
(b) if so, the outcome of the talks;

208
(c) whether any negotiations have been
held with regard to Preferential Trade
Agreement (PTA) as a part of FTA; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
SEZs approved for Haryana and
Uttarakhand
863. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) how many SEZ proposals have been
approved for Haryana and Uttarakhand;
(b) which are the major industrial
activities for which SEZs have been
approved in Uttarakhand and Haryana
separately; and
(c) whether there is any proposal to set
up a tourism SEZ in Uttarakhand?
